Title: Combat Visuals Improved
Description:
Various changes to melee animations and floating combat text.

-- Melee Animations --
Limits the number of melee animations displayed per turn. Mostly affects builds/npcs that hit multiple times per round.

-- Floating Combat Text --
All combat text produced from a single turn is now immediately displayed instead of the default delay between each message.

Option to condense all damage text per entity into a single number.

Option to slightly randomize the location/direction of text. This is useful if you choose not to condense damage text.

**Note**
This mod relies on Harmony which currently doesn't work on MacOS.
